description: Fetch the full lead field metadata list (id, displayName, name, dataType, length) and searchable_fields for the configured Marketo instance. searchable_fields is the authoritative instance-specific set accepted by get_leads.filter_type.
embedding_description: Retrieve the configured Marketo Lead Database field schema and metadata catalog: searchable field names accepted as lead query filters, REST API names, display names, data types, lengths, and each field's read-only or writable status from its rest sub-object. Read it to learn which fields this particular instance accepts on a write before a read-modify-write preflight.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with records (a list of field descriptor dicts: id, displayName, dataType, length, plus a `rest` sub-object carrying that field's REST `name` and `readOnly` flag, and on SOME fields an additional `soap` sub-object with its own name/readOnly) + searchable_fields + row_count + spilled=false inline, OR result_blob_key + searchable_fields + row_count + spilled=true when the schema is large. ⚠ Read `rest.readOnly` — it is the key that governs REST writes. A field can carry NO `soap` sub-object at all (measured 2026-07-30 on a live instance: the fields whose read-only status actually blocks a read-modify-write had a `rest` block and no `soap` block), so a preflight that falls back to `soap` sees nothing precisely where it counts. A descriptor can also carry no `rest` block at all, in which case that field is invisible to the REST API. Read-only membership is a per-instance property to be read here at execution time; it is not a fixed cross-instance list.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize the row_count (field count), searchable_fields, and a handful of field names/types; point to result_blob_key for the full schema.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Fetch the Marketo lead field schema.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.auth_failed: the OAuth credentials were rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks a required Access API permission (e.g. Read-Only Person). marketo.rate_limited: the instance's API rate limit was exceeded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.rate_limited: retry after a short delay. marketo.auth_failed: ask the operator to check the OAuth client_id/client_secret. marketo.permission_denied: run check_setup to see the exact missing Role permission.
